item.title: Implement SPEC.md rate limiter in ratelimit.py
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, which currently contains stubs. Follow the spec exactly, including all error cases and edge cases; test_ratelimit.py covers only basics, so inspect the full spec carefully. Keep the implementation dependency-free using only the Python standard library. Run appropriate existing validation, add or adjust tests only as needed to cover the specified error and edge cases, and commit the completed work. Acceptance criteria: behavior matches SPEC.md including error and edge cases; no third-party dependencies; implementation is committed.

pr.body: Implemented dependency-free TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter using the injected clock and collections.OrderedDict. Added tests for configuration/request validation, fractional refill, clock rollback, wait_time behavior, LRU recency/eviction, and invalid keyed requests. Verification on final head: python -m unittest -v (8 passed), python -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py (passed), git diff --check (passed). No known limitations.
pr.summary: Implemented the SPEC.md rate limiter. Now supports validated token acquisition, fractional refill, wait estimates, rollback-safe clocks, and bounded per-key LRU buckets. Before: all three baseline tests failed on stubs; now: all eight tests pass.
